policy.resolution: Only an explicit alias inside its window may change the provider file name.
policy.outside_window: Use the format-only provider symbol; never infer a rename, merger, or ticker reuse.
policy.share_class: No alias crosses a share class. DISCK is deliberately absent.

evidence: coverage_dispositions.json#symbols/GPS: provider GPS has no data and GAP identifies The Gap, Inc.
coverage_dispositions.json#symbols/GPS: GPS was removed from the historical Constituents on 2022-02-03.
Provider GAP history starts before the first GPS gap session and is used only for the dated GPS member window.
aliases.notes: The end date is the last GPS Constituents session, not a claim that GAP was always the correct provider label.

aliases.identity: Fortune Brands Home & Security / Fortune Brands Innovations
evidence: coverage_dispositions.json#symbols/FBHS: FBHS was removed on 2022-12-19 and FBIN provider history begins on the listing date.

coverage_dispositions.json#symbols/ADS: ADS was removed from the historical Constituents on 2020-06-22.
